clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/upsert with bool_f field set to string value 'true' (should fail type validation but succeeds)
clean_repro.observed: HTTP 200 OK with upsertCount=1, accepting string 'true' for Bool field

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_type_bool_001 - dataType == Bool (schema constraint requiring boolean type)

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 upsert handler → checkAndSetData() → cast.ToBoolE() for Bool fields → aggressive type coercion accepting any non-empty string as true
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:REST v2 API使用github.com/spf13/cast库的ToBoolE函数处理Bool字段类型转换,该函数对所有非空字符串(包括"false"、"0")都返回true,完全没有做语义验证。这是rest-v2-data-type-handling bug shape的经典实例。

falsification.probe: 验证:bool_f字段值为字符串"false"时仍然被接受为true,证明类型转换逻辑错误
falsification.observed: 原始日志显示bool_f='false'返回HTTP 200,说明"false"字符串被强制转换为true值

mundane_explanation.surviving: rest-v2_data_type_handling - 确认是REST v2 API层的数据类型序列化缺陷

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus; REST v2 and gRPC divergent validation: REST v2 accepting values the gRPC path rejects (maintainers treat cross-channel inconsistency as a defect and fix it)
cognition_match.note: 候选命中developer_cognition.json中记录的REST v2数据类型处理盲点,维护者明确将gRPC/REST v2验证不一致视为缺陷

verdicts.rationale: 干净复现成功:REST v2 /entities/upsert端点接受Bool字段值为字符串类型(如"true"、"false"、"1"、"42"),违反Schema中定义的Bool类型约束。源码接地发现internal/distributed/proxy/httpserver/utils.go的checkAndSetData函数使用github.com/spf13/cast库的ToBoolE进行类型转换,该函数对所有非空字符串都返回true,包括语义上应该为false的"false"和"0"字符串。这符合bug_shapes.json中rest-v2-data-type-handling的历史模式(milvus issue #52232、#52230、#52229等26个实例),且命中developer_cognition.json中记录的维护者盲点('REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues')。三视角聚合:(A)契约视角-DataType_Bool约束明确要求boolean类型,API实测接受string值,verdict_A=CONFIRMED;(B)物理约束-Bool字段客观上只能为true/false二值,API接受任意字符串,verdict_B=CONFIRMED;(C)行为优雅-API未做by-design注释,且此行为导致数据语义错误("false"被存为true),verdict_C=CONFIRMED。聚合规则:A=CONFIRMED → final=CONFIRMED。

physical.objective_constraint: Bool fields must be binary (true/false), not arbitrary strings

perspective_analysis.aggregation_applied: verdict_A=CONFIRMED and verdict_B=CONFIRMED → final=CONFIRMED (contract and physical violations override behavioral grace)
